description: Annual taxes of a self-employed person in Lithuania working under an individual activity certificate (individuali veikla pagal pažymą, IV): income tax (GPM) with its credit, and Sodra contributions (VSD, PSD). Use for "kiek mokesčių nuo individualios veiklos pajamų", "IV mokesčiai", "GPM, VSD ir PSD nuo pajamų". Row ids: pelnas (profit), gpm-baze (income tax base), kreditas (income tax credit), gpm (income tax), sodros-baze (contribution base), vsd (social insurance), psd-nuo-pajamu (health insurance on income), psd-minimumas (monthly health insurance minimum), psd (health insurance payable), viso (GPM + VSD + PSD).

additional_pension.description: true when the person pays the additional pension accumulation contribution (papildomas pensijų kaupimas). Omitted: false.

expense_method.description: "actual": deduct the expenses given in `expenses` (faktinės išlaidos). "flat_30": deduct a flat 30 percent of income instead (30 % išlaidų). Omitted: actual.

expenses.description: Deductible expenses for the year (leidžiami atskaitymai), without VSD and PSD: the calculator subtracts those itself. Only with expense_method "actual"; must not exceed income. Omitted: 0. In euros, at most 2 decimal places.

health_insured_elsewhere.description: true when a job or the state already covers health insurance (PSD jau dengia darbas arba valstybė): the monthly PSD minimum is then not counted, PSD on income still is. Omitted: false.

income.description: Income from the activity for the year (pajamos). In euros, at most 2 decimal places.

months.description: Months of activity in the year (veiklos mėnesiai per metus); the monthly health insurance minimum is counted for each. Omitted: 12.

year.description: Tax year (metai): 2026 or 2027. Omit it to use the current year in Vilnius time, as the site's calculators do.

name: calculate_individual_activity_tax

apiUrl.description: The same calculation as JSON over plain HTTP GET.

calculatorInput.description: The same input as the site calculator read it, defaults filled in (Lithuanian field names).

checkedAt.description: Date the figures were last checked against the sources, YYYY-MM-DD.

message.description: Conditions and assumptions the site shows with the result (Lithuanian).

preliminary.description: Rate fields that come from a draft, not from an adopted act. Empty when all are adopted.

rows.description: Result lines, in the order the site shows them.

cents.description: Amount in integer euro cents. For the line with id "dienos" it is a number of days.

label.description: Label as shown on the site (Lithuanian).

value.description: Formatted value as shown on the site.

sources.description: Primary sources (VMI, Sodra, legal acts) behind the figures.

taxYear.description: Tax year of the rates used.

url.description: The buhalteris.ai calculator page showing this same calculation.

warning.description: Shown when a rule could not be applied reliably. Empty otherwise.

yearNote.description: The note the site shows under the year choice (Lithuanian): which rates apply and which are still preliminary.

title: Individual activity tax calculator (individualios veiklos mokesčiai)
